name: Media Integrity Scanner
description: Validates media file integrity using FFmpeg. Detects corrupt, truncated, and damaged files without impacting playback.
overview: Production-safe media integrity scanning with two-phase validation, I/O throttling, and admin dashboard. This is the development/pre-release channel -- builds here are cut automatically from the tip of main and are not guaranteed stable.
